policy: Snapshot testing degrades into 'regenerate until green' unless the reviewer and the grounds are named. No golden file in this registry may be regenerated without the named reviewer and one of the stated grounds.

baselines.baseline: Canonical assembled Markdown per `F-SYNTH` and `F-GRAPHIC` document
baselines.grounds: Accepted only alongside a deliberate transcription-prompt version bump or a stated assembly-rule change; never "the model changed its mind"
baselines.produced_by: M-INGEST: one canonical Markdown artifact per logical document

baselines.baseline: The exported package archive for the reference package
baselines.grounds: Accepted only with a schema-version bump or a declared export-format change
baselines.oracle: Golden file over the archive's canonical listing and per-member digests

baselines.baseline: The CSV and per-student PDF exports
baselines.grounds: Accepted only with a declared export-mapping change; a diff in a *mark* is a defect, not a baseline update
baselines.oracle: Golden file, with the mark columns compared separately and never accepted on diff
baselines.produced_by: M-GRADE: export from a specified grade revision

baselines.baseline: Rendered HTML of the review queue, the rollup and the student view
baselines.grounds: Accepted for deliberate layout changes; **never** for a change that removes a §11.6 invariant's rendered element
baselines.oracle: Golden file, plus a separate invariant-element check that no diff can waive
baselines.produced_by: M-CONSOLE: review queue, rollup and student view rendering

baselines.baseline: Per-criterion score distributions of `F-FROZEN` on each backend
baselines.grounds: A shift with an unchanged package is build substitution (`FR-CONFORM-08`), not a baseline to update
baselines.oracle: Statistical: per-criterion distribution over the frozen set, with n and threshold stated. A shift under an unchanged package must be reported as build substitution
baselines.produced_by: M-CONFORM: frozen-set re-run and build-substitution detection

baselines.reviewer: Nobody may accept a diff casually
baselines.grounds: A changed `work_id` means every stored result for that shape is now unreachable. Requires an explicit migration note
baselines.oracle: Golden file over the reference input tuples, plus pairwise distinctness
